papers.reason: Narrative review synthesizing AI-writing risks (Table 2: hallucination, plagiarism/misattribution, skill erosion, black-box limitations, overreliance) and cataloguing named institutional policies (Table 3); it summarizes others' policies rather than proposing or using its own scheme for classifying a disclosure, attribution, or provenance claim.
